title: Be a Human Being
coreMove: Stillness grows when you protect moments that do not have to earn their keep: a meal, a prayer, a walk, or a Sabbath block where no one is being measured.

exampleSpecs.audience: Jin, a consultant who turns every break into prep
exampleSpecs.stakes: A scheduled rest block may become another productivity tactic.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A visible rule protects Sabbath time from being recruited by work.

exampleSpecs.audience: Derek and Nadine, two friends leaving the same poetry group
exampleSpecs.stakes: The same open hour becomes either another metric or a real pause.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A walk is allowed to remain unproductive instead of becoming content.

exampleSpecs.audience: Harper, a designer who treats rest as lost billable time
exampleSpecs.stakes: A peer must reframe rest before Harper cancels it again.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A mentor sentence reframes the stuck view in one conversation.

exampleSpecs.audience: Melodie, a learner who confuses loafing with quitting
exampleSpecs.stakes: A class must turn confusion about non-doing into practice.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The learner's confusion becomes the material for teaching.

exampleSpecs.audience: Christophe, a manager who measures every private hour
exampleSpecs.stakes: The same evening routine either treats the body as equipment or as a life.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: An evening routine drops one private metric so rest can remain rest.

exampleSpecs.audience: people whose calendars turn living into output
exampleSpecs.stakes: a person may start treating every ordinary moment as proof of usefulness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small comparison of artifacts shows where unmeasured life disappeared.
